scenario: A property management company processes a batch of rental applications. A CSV file containing applicant records is parsed and normalized, each applicant's urgency and intent signals are scored to produce a priority ranking, and a final screening report is generated to guide the leasing agent's approval decisions.
info_flow: csv-pipeline reads and normalizes the applicant CSV, producing a structured list of lead records -> sentiment-priority-scorer scores each applicant on urgency, intent, recency, and sentiment to produce priority_score and priority_bucket -> reporting generates a structured screening recommendation report listing approved and rejected applicants.
